adventures.resultSource: Laurel individual result for Alex Ford, bib 383, corroborated by user screenshot. Chip time and placements are authoritative. adventures.matchSource: User-confirmed participation + Strava activity screenshots + individual Laurel result bib 383 + organizer-linked Strava course 3479586316635225542
adventures.note: Completed October 11, 2026 in 2:03:54 (official chip time), 60th of 222 overall. Organizer course reconstructed from all 1,676 published coordinates. This is an organizer-course reconstruction, not personal GPS. Strava separately shows 13.50 miles, 2:03:21 moving, 2:04:05 elapsed, and 390 ft gain. Watch mile splits are retained separately from official results. The timing page header uses the weekend opening date October 10; its checkpoint timestamps and the activity confirm October 11. Some intermediate provider checkpoint distances/locations are inconsistent, so no synthetic timing track is asserted. Reconcile with the original personal GPS during the next annual Strava-export audit.
